question: A print shop charges $0.12 per page for the first 500 pages of an order, $0.09 per page for pages 501 through 2,000, and $0.07 per page for every page after page 2,000. Binding costs $3.50 per booklet. A school orders 70 booklets of 36 pages each as a single order. If the subtotal (printing plus binding) is more than $500, the shop takes 12% off the subtotal. Sales tax of 5% is then charged on the amount after any discount, and a flat $25 delivery fee is added after tax (the delivery fee is not taxed). The shop's van can carry 40 boxes of 50 booklets each. What is the total amount the school pays, in dollars?

Dana earns $31 per hour. In any week, hours worked Monday through Saturday beyond the first 40 are paid at 1.5 times her hourly rate. Hours worked on a Sunday are paid at double her hourly rate and do not count toward the 40-hour threshold. In week one she works 50 hours Monday through Saturday and 6 hours on Sunday. In week two she works 36 hours Monday through Saturday and does not work on Sunday. 20% of her total gross pay for the two weeks is withheld for taxes, and after that a $40 union fee is deducted. Her coworker Sam earns $2 more per hour than Dana. How many dollars does Dana take home for the two weeks?

A water tank holds 3,000 liters and starts with 360 liters in it. Pump A adds 36 liters per minute and runs the whole time. Pump B adds 36 liters per minute but only switches on 12 minutes after the start, and then stays on. A drain removes 12 liters per minute; it is closed at first, opens at the moment the water level first reaches 1,800 liters, and stays open from then on. The tank is 3 meters tall. How many minutes after the start does the tank become completely full?

A recipe that makes 8 servings needs 1.5 cups of milk and 3 eggs. A caterer must make 112 servings and scales the recipe exactly. Use 1 cup = 240 mL. The caterer already has 400 mL of milk and 5 eggs. Milk is sold only in 1-liter cartons at $1.29 each, and eggs only in cartons of 12 at $3.75 each. The recipe also needs salt, which the caterer has plenty of. The caterer buys the smallest number of whole cartons of each that is enough. How many dollars does the caterer spend?

A warehouse has 510 units in stock before opening on Monday. On each of the five days Monday through Friday, the same thing happens: first a delivery of 190 units arrives, and then the warehouse ships out exactly 20% of the units it has on hand at that moment. On Wednesday, after that day's shipment has gone out, 22 units are found to be defective and are thrown away. On Friday evening, after that day's shipment, 50 units shipped earlier in the week are returned and put back in stock. The warehouse employs 14 people. How many units are in stock at the end of Friday?

Lena went shopping with a certain amount of money. At the first shop she spent one quarter of the money she had, plus $7 more. At the second shop she spent half of the money she had left at that point, plus $5 more. At the third shop she spent half of what she then had left, plus $11 more. On the way home she was given a $25 refund for an item she had returned the week before. She arrived home with $129. How many dollars did she have when she set out?

Towns A and B are 350 km apart on a straight railway. A freight train leaves A toward B at 8:00 at 66 km/h. A passenger train leaves B toward A at 8:20 at a constant 96 km/h. After the freight train has been moving for exactly 1 hour, it stops for 20 minutes, and then continues toward B at 45 km/h. How many kilometers from A are the two trains when they meet?

A vat contains 120 liters of a solution that is 40% acid by volume. First, 12 liters of the solution are drained off and replaced with 12 liters of pure water, and the vat is stirred until uniform. Then 25 liters of the new mixture are drained off and replaced with 25 liters of a solution that is 80% acid. How many liters of pure acid are in the vat at the end?

3 years ago, Ana was three times as old as Cal was then. 5 years from now, Ben will be three times as old as Cal will be then. The sum of the current ages of Ana, Ben and Cal is 81. How old is Ana now?

Working alone at a steady rate, crew A could pave a certain road in 20 days, crew B in 30 days, and crew C in 12 days. Crews A and B start the job together. After 2 full days, crew A leaves for good and crew C joins crew B. After 2 more full days, some of crew B's equipment fails, and from then on crew B works at half of its normal rate while crew C continues normally. How many days does the whole job take from start to finish?
How many integers from 1 to 7,165 inclusive are divisible by 4 or by 14 (or by both), but are not divisible by 21?
How many distinct arrangements of all the letters of the word COMMITTEE have no two vowels next to each other? (The vowels are A, E, I, O and U. Arrangements that look identical count once.)

A robot starts at the point (0, 0) on a grid and must reach the point (7, 8). Each move takes it exactly one unit to the right or exactly one unit up. Its path must pass through the point (3, 2) and must not pass through the point (6, 4). How many different paths can the robot take?
What is the remainder when 3^578 + 17^580 is divided by 1000? (Here ^ means exponentiation.)
How many integers from 1000 to 9999 inclusive have digits that add up to exactly 22 and do not contain the digit 5 anywhere?

A bag contains 5 red, 3 green and 7 blue marbles. Four marbles are drawn at random without replacement. The probability that the four marbles include at least one marble of each of the three colors can be written as p/q, where p and q are positive integers with no common factor greater than 1. What is p + q?

A lab culture starts with 152 bacteria. Every hour, exactly two things happen, in this order: first the number of bacteria increases by 50% (if that is not a whole number, it is rounded down to a whole number), and then exactly 28 bacteria are removed for testing. How many bacteria are in the culture after 10 hours?

A sensor takes a reading every 7 hours 25 minutes. The 1st reading is taken on a Monday at 09:50 (24-hour clock). Consider the 170th reading. Let d be the day of the week on which it is taken, with Monday = 1, Tuesday = 2, and so on up to Sunday = 7, and let h and m be the hour (0 to 23) and minute (0 to 59) shown on a 24-hour clock at that moment. What is 10000*d + 100*h + m?
When the number 257! (the factorial of 257) is written in base 45, how many zeros does it end with?

74 people stand in a circle, numbered 1 to 74 clockwise. Counting starts at person 1 and goes clockwise: person 1 says "1", the next person still in the circle says "2", and so on. Whoever says "3" leaves the circle, and the count starts again at "1" with the next person clockwise who is still in the circle. (So the first person to leave is person 3.) This continues until one person remains. What is the number of the last person remaining?
